title.suggested: Tom Allen Expected to Return from England to Fight Johnny Dwyer

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Tom Allen was expected to recross the Atlantic to contest Johnny Dwyer's claim to the American title, and his St. Louis backer said a match was only a question of time.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Tuesday Morning, May 13, 1879, page 3.

facts.fact: Allen was in England in May 1879 and was expected to recross the Atlantic to contest Johnny Dwyer's claim to the American championship
Allen's St. Louis backer said a match between Allen and Dwyer was a mere question of time, and Allen's friends would make it for as much money as the opposition wanted
Allen's backer said his brother was then in England and that Allen would almost certainly accompany him on his return to America

notes: 'His brother' most likely means the backer's brother, though the wording is ambiguous.
